During the [[First Jedi Purge]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]] was forced to '''duel''' the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Visas Marr]] when she attacked her on the [[Ebon Hawk]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Who are you? What have you done to the crew?|Meetra Surik|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
During the [[First Jedi Purge]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Nihilus]] had sent his [[Shadow Hand]], the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Visas Marr]], to assassinate [[Meetra Surik]]. Marr's search for the origin of the echoes lead her to Surik, a former [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] who had lost her connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during the war's [[Battle of Malachor V|culminating battle]] at [[Malachor V]]. The general alone returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to answer to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and defend her actions in disobeying them by joining [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in his crusade against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] threat. As a result, she was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
[[File:VisasBowstoNihilus.png|thumb|left|225px|[[Darth Nihilus]] commands [[Visas Marr]] to seek out Meetra Surik.]]
After roaming the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] for nearly a decade, Surik had returned to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] space and was being hunted by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] who believed her to be the last [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. In an effort to save the Jedi Order, Surik set out on a mission to find the [[Lost Jedi|Jedi Masters]] that had not been present at the [[Conclave at Katarr|conclave on Katarr]]. During her journey, Surik experienced a burgeoning reconnection to the Force and any subsequent decisions she made sent tremors throughout the Force, thus allowing Marr to find her. Marr infiltrated Surik's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', and incapacitated the crew.<ref name="KotORII game" />

==The Duel==
{{Quote|My lightsaber... you have destroyed it. I yield... master. It is as I heard through the Force. My life... for yours.''"<br />"''Arise – but do not attack me again.''"<br />"'''''Kill''' me, I beg you. I... it was not my wish to challenge you... and I '''must''' pay the price.''"<br />"''I will not kill you.''"<br />"''I... have nothing to offer you. Your strength is superior... It is as I felt.|Visas Marr and Meetra Surik|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
{{GameLS}}
During a brief intense [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] Surik destroyed Marr's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] defeated, and wounded her. Convinced of Surik's superior strength, Marr yielded and begged Surik to end her life, for the alternative was death by her master's hand for her failure. When Surik refused, Marr pledged her life to her, abandoning Nihilus before losing consciousness.<ref name="KotORII game" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Now I've seen everything. This woman... she's a Miraluka. I didn't think any were left in this part of the galaxy.''"<br />"''What's a Miraluka?''"<br />"''Yeah, they're a pretty secretive race. I heard that some of their kind become Jedi, but a Sith? That's... well, that's a new one. I'm not sure how you'd go about killing one. It'd be tricky.''"<br />"''Killing one?''"<br />"''Just mentioning it – she looks like she's suffered enough wounds already... even after the beating you gave her.''"<br />"''Is her kind rare?''"<br />"''I heard they had a colony on the Mid Rim, almost halfway between Onderon and Dantooine. Then... it wasn't there anymore. The whole planet was wiped out, nothing left alive, no one knows why.''"<br />"''Is she going to be all right?''"<br />"''Well, some of her wounds are pretty bad - looks like she was already carrying her share of scars, though. I think she'll recover, yeah.''"<br />"''If her condition changes, let me know - I didn't want to hurt her.|Atton Rand and Meetra Surik discussing Visas Marr|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
Surik then took the unconscious woman to the ship's medical bay. This act of mercy was met by surprise from Surik's companion, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the ''Ebon Hawk'', [[Atton Rand]], who was uneasy in the presence of powerful Force users, as the Miraluka were known to be. He also expressed his amazement at seeing a Miraluka [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], saying that he had heard of Miraluka Jedi, but never Sith, further speculating that he was unsure as to how to go about killing one. The idea of killing Marr was met by incredulity on the part of Surik, who voiced her regret for having hurt the Miraluka during their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. Rand reassured her that Marr's injuries would heal, noticing that even though some of her wounds were severe, she looked like she had suffered from many more in the past. While Rand grudgingly accepted Marr, [[Kreia]], Surik's informal master, met her arrival with barely concealed contempt. She was of the opinion that the Miraluka's ability to see through the Force was wasted on her people and that she should be considered a servant. Furthermore, Kreia felt it necessary to remind Surik that the Sith were often betrayed by their own apprentices and that even though Marr had pledged herself to Surik, she was [[Force-bond/Legends|bound]] to other masters, thus insinuating that Marr's loyalty would always be suspect.<ref name="KotORII game" />

Wary of Kreia's attitude towards Marr, Surik nonetheless sought her advice regarding the change Marr had brought about in her eyesight during their clash. While Kreia explained this alteration of Surik's perception was nothing that hadn't already been present, the elder woman had nothing but utter disdain for the forceful and "crude methods" that were the mark of the Sith. Surik accepted her into the ship's crew and retrained her in the ways of a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]]. With Marr gained as an ally, Surik knew she could not hide her presence for long, however she also knew that she had an inroad into finding at least one of the Sith Lords who hunted her.<ref name="KotORII game" />

Marr's first genuine encounter with Surik left her disquieted. Unused to the mercy shown by Surik not only toward her, but others as well, Marr believed that this type of action would weaken Surik for the enemies she had to face in the near future. Nevertheless, impressed by Surik's skills, Marr rediscovered hope and came to consider that the universe was perhaps not as her master had shown her, and that, with her help, Surik would be able to stop him. The fact that her master neither understood nor ''saw'' Surik as she did was of some comfort to her. However, Marr cautioned Surik that she would need to understand why this was so if Surik was to have a chance of defeating Nihilus. She refused to guide Surik to him untested and without her potential realized, as Marr felt the Jedi was not yet ready to face such a threat. She foresaw that Surik and Nihilus would meet in the near future, however.<ref name="KotORII game" />
